description: This file defines interfaces for App Notifications within the WPEFramework, including methods for subscribing, emitting events, and handling app event notifications.

classes.name: IAppNotifications
classes.description: Interface for managing app notifications, including subscribe, emit, and cleanup functionalities.

classes.name: IAppNotificationHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling app event notifications and emit callbacks.

classes.name: IEmitter
classes.description: Nested interface for emitting events to apps.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Register or unregister for Firebolt subscription requests based on the provided context, module, and event.

methods.name: Emit
methods.description: Dispatch an event with payload to all or specific apps based on appId.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleanup contexts associated with a specific connectionId and origin.

methods.name: HandleAppEventNotifier
methods.description: Handle expectations for app event notifications, providing a callback interface and event details.

methods.name: Emit
methods.description: Dispatch an event for a specific registration, optionally for a specific app.
